records.artifact: CMMC Phase 2 (Level 2 C3PAO in applicable solicitations) — SUSPENDED
records.current_version: Phase 1 in force since 2025-11-10; Phase 2 suspended 2026-07-13
records.trigger_signal: Reinstatement announcement, guidance at the conclusion of the CIO's 60-day review, or amendment to 32 CFR 170 / DFARS

detection.match: CMMC Phase 2 (Level 2 C3PAO in applicable solicitations) — SUSPENDED

records.notes: Original schedule: 32 CFR 170.3(e) 'Phase 2. Begins one calendar year following the start date of Phase 1'; Phase 1 began on the 48 CFR rule effective date 2025-11-10 (90 FR 43560) -> derived original Phase 2 date 2026-11-10, confirmed by the release ('originally scheduled to come into effect on November 10, 2026'). Suspended 2026-07-13: only CMMC Level 1 (Self) or Level 2 (Self) may be designated; no Level 2 (C3PAO) or Level 3 (DIBCAC) designations; no waivers during the review; COs directed to amend active solicitations and modify existing contracts before the next option period. DFARS 252.204-7012 remains in effect. Policy pause, NOT a regulatory change: 32 CFR 170 and the 48 CFR rule remain in force.

provenance.verbatim: The upcoming November 2026 transition to Phase 2 of CMMC implementation is suspended.
